scope.goal: Add runtime runner dispatch so workflow-runner can use a workflow-specific execution path while all other agents keep the current chat/session loop.
included: Add an agent runtime runner discriminator, defaulting existing agents to chat.
Map workflow-runner to the workflow runner path.
Update session processing to dispatch by runner.
Implement workflow-runner fallback to normal chat behavior when workflow mode is not warranted.
Route workflow-worthy requests through workflow create, validate, start, status, and decision operations.
Keep worker node execution on the existing chat runner with node assignment prompts.
excluded: Replacing all existing workflow executor internals in one step.
Changing ordinary agent behavior except for runner selection metadata defaults.

required: focused session processor tests for chat vs workflow runner dispatch
focused workflow runner tests for fallback and workflow-worthy routing
